denied: denied: create_package permission_denied

ghcr.io rejected the push: only the namespace owner can create new packages under ghcr.io/sophium/.

To bootstrap the first version of this image, get a personal access token from the GitHub account that owns ghcr.io/sophium/:
  1. Sign into github.com as that account.
  2. Open https://github.com/settings/tokens/new (classic).
  3. Generate a token with scopes: write:packages and read:packages.
  4. docker logout ghcr.io
  5. echo $TOKEN | docker login ghcr.io -u sophium --password-stdin
  6. Re-run erun push.

After the package exists the owner can grant Write access to others (per-package settings, or via "Inherit access from source repository" on a linked repo). Future versions can then be pushed by anyone with that access — no PAT needed.
